description: A unit is one dwelling, suite or tenancy of a building that holds several (an apartment, a condo, a hotel room, a shop): a named group of rooms (zones) under the building. Its members may span levels (a duplex). A zone belongs to at most one unit; a zone in no unit is common area (a corridor, a lobby, the stairs). A single-family house has no units. Replace the rooms a unit holds with this list: a zone left out leaves the unit and becomes common area, an empty list empties it. Every zone must be on a level of the unit's building.

memberZoneIds.description: The rooms the unit holds from now on, by zone ids from get_zones or create_room, on any level of the building. A zone already in another unit is refused (zone_in_other_unit, naming that unit) unless move is true.

move.description: true: a zone already in another unit leaves that unit for this one.

unitId.description: The unit, by an id from create_unit or list_units.
